source_audits.finding: A-001 inherited handoff target binding gap
A-001/A-002/A-003 post-write refreeze and deterministic gate failures

controls.procedure: Resolve PR #671 and verify repository, issue, PR, refs and exact material SHA before accepting or publishing the handoff.
controls.expected: Only a fresh package bound to issue #615 / PR #671 at the current material candidate is eligible.
controls.observed: Historical inherited and stale certificates are rejected; the current refreeze subject is material head da21af37ceaed5a3c59608277f148a5ce7e04faa.

controls.procedure: Replay npm run format:check as part of the CRITICAL exact-head validation after the final material edit.
controls.expected: Formatting gate exits zero before lint, typecheck, tests and build proceed.
controls.observed: Delivery V2 run 35540624712 on da21af37ceaed5a3c59608277f148a5ce7e04faa passed format check and continued through the remaining CRITICAL validation steps.

controls.procedure: Execute the registered Chrome route scenarios at desktop and mobile after the filter-action reflow regression is present.
controls.expected: No accidental horizontal overflow and keyboard-visible route content remain operable.
controls.observed: Statement visual run 35540624747 on da21af37ceaed5a3c59608277f148a5ce7e04faa passed the admin institutions, financial indexes and legacy remuneration registered scenarios, including desktop/mobile overflow checks.
